footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Full Truck Alliance: after CN¥50.9M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 11.1% to CN¥12.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 63.0%, versus 54.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 67.5% to CN¥4.1B, a 33.2% margin.

Net income rose 43.6% to CN¥4.4B, or CN¥0.21 per share. Operating cash flow was CN¥4.6B and free cash flow CN¥4.5B, versus CN¥2.9B; Full Truck Alliance returned CN¥1.5B through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Cash ended the year at CN¥17.1B.
